CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 12, 2026 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the Public Financing Authority approve the minutes of the regular meeting of May 13, 2025.
5.1 PFA Minutes

NEW BUSINESS
6.1.
ELECTION OF OFFICERS – It is recommended the Public Financing Authority elect a Chairperson and a Vice Chairperson, re-elect Jeff Boynton as Executive Director, and re-elect Anne Haraksin as Secretary.
6.1 Election of Officers

PUBLIC COMMENTS

11.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
11.1
PRESENTATION OF AWARDS TO LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENTS - It is recommended the City Council present Certificates of Recognition and the Board of Directors of the La Mirada Community Foundation present scholarship checks to the Bob Jenkins Community Service Scholarship recipients Joy An, Benjamin Cantrell, Ruby Chastine, Annika Hernandez, Daniel Morales, Julissa Romo, and Tatiana Saucedo.
11.1 Scholarship Recipients
11.2
PROCLAMATION FOR OLDER AMERICANS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2026 as Older Americans Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Dr. Cathy Alvarez.
11.2 Proclamation for Older Americans
11.3
PROCLAMATION FOR ASIAN AMERICAN AND PACIFIC ISLANDER HERITAGE MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2026 as Asian American and Pacific Islander Heritage Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Los Angeles County Assistant Fire Chief Khoi Dao.
11.3 Proclamation for Asian American and Pacific Islander
11.4
PROCLAMATION FOR WATER SAFETY MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2026 as Water Safety Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Aquatics Supervisor Dustin Balke.
11.4 Proclamation for Water Safety
12.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
13.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
13.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES – It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of April 28, 2026.
13.1 City Council Minutes
13.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER – It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 12, 2026 in the total amount of $2,347,725.67.
13.2 Warrant Register
13.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING FEBRUARY 2026 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending February 2026.
13.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
13.4
APPROVAL AGREEMENT WITH MGT IMPACT SOLUTIONS, LLC FOR STATE MANDATED COST REIMBURSEMENT SERVICES (SB 90) – It is recommended the City Council approve a contract with MGT Impact Solutions, LLC and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
13.4 MGT Impact Solutions Agreement
13.5
LA MIRADA CHAMBER OF COMMERCE FUNDING REQUEST – It is recommended the City Council approve funding for the La Mirada Chamber of Commerce in the amount of $8,500 to support Chamber programming.
13.5 La Mirada Chamber of Commerce Request
13.6
ENERGY CONSERVATION AND INFRASTRUCTURE RENEWAL PROGRAM – ACCEPTANCE OF WORK – It is recommended the City Council accept the improvements constructed by Climatec LLC; authorize the City Clerk to file a Notice of Completion with the County Recorder; and authorize the payment of the retention money pursuant to the agreement.
13.6 Engergy Convervation Acceptance of Work
13.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2023-03, NEW CABARET LOUNGE AT THE LA MIRADA THEATRE – APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER NO. 3 – It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 3 for Capital Improvement Project No. 2023-03, New Cabaret Lounge at the La Mirada Theatre, in the amount of $37,773.18.
13.7 CIP No. 2023-03 New Cabaret Lounge
14.

14.1
RESOLUTION NO. 26-13 WAIVING THE FORMAL BID PROCESS AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF ONE CHEVROLET SILVERADO 6500HD TRUCK WITH A SERVICE BODY UPFIT – It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 26-13 waiving the formal bid process and authorizing the purchase of one Chevrolet Silverado 6500HD truck with a service body upfit in the amount of $110,553.94.
14.1 Reso. No. 26-13 Vehicle Purchase
